concerns.text: The augmented model includes a learned linear projection head (768→512) that the baseline does not have (baseline uses zero‑padding). This introduces a capacity confound: any performance gain could stem from the extra parameters rather than the predicted visual latent. The plan should add a comparable‑capacity control (e.g., a random projection head) for the baseline.

ResNet‑18 pretrained on ImageNet is used as the source of “visual layout latents”. ImageNet features may not capture the structural/layout information relevant to scientific documents, raising construct‑validity concerns about whether the latent truly represents the intended construct.

The downstream evaluation uses the DocVQA test set for both model selection and final reporting, but the plan does not specify a separate validation split or any hold‑out strategy to prevent over‑fitting of hyper‑parameters (e.g., early‑stop patience, learning‑rate schedule) to the test data. This threatens the internal validity of the reported performance gains.
